description: A formal, Parisian-influenced dining room of striking monochromatic elegance. The walls are clad floor to ceiling in white-painted applied panel molding — deep-set rectangular raised panels framed by architraves in multiple profiles, creating a sumptuous architectural backdrop. The herringbone parquet floor is pale warm blonde oak. A large dark espresso-stained rectangular dining table seats eight in upholstered open-arm dining chairs — cream linen seats and backs with ebonized dark frames and cabriolet legs. The table is set for a formal dinner with white plates, folded linen napkins, tall crystal wine glasses, silver candlestick holders bearing slim white tapered candles, and three large white ceramic urn vases densely filled with white hydrangeas and white garden roses. Above the table, centered on the back wall, a large square canvas in an ebonized frame depicts a dark, moody figurative or portrait subject in blacks, deep greys, and muted ochre. Warm glowing light emanates softly from both sides of the back wall, casting warm vertical washes of amber light against the white paneling and framing the artwork. The atmosphere is theatrical, aristocratic, and intensely curated. Camera is at standing eye-level, centered symmetrically, looking straight at the back wall with the table in the foreground and artwork behind.
